# Benchmark results (auto-generated by tools/benchmark/report.py)

21 models (15 held-out), 287 successful runs. MPJPE = mean joint position error over 14 joints (neck, head, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, ankles), in % of character height. Part accuracy = share of vertices whose dominant bone lies in the same body part (14 parts) as in the artist's rig.

## Joint placement - held-out models

| Variant | Realistic MPJPE %H | Stylised MPJPE %H | All MPJPE %H | PCK@5%H | Runs < 8%H |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Width profile (geometry only) | 3.4 | 14.5 | 5.6 | 76 | 77% |
| + 2D keypoints | 4.6 | 15.5 | 6.8 | 68 | 70% |
| + proportion reconcile (v1 system) | 5.0 | 14.4 | 6.9 | 66 | 63% |
| Arm-anchored geometry only | 3.7 | 5.9 | 4.1 | 81 | 100% |
| Arm-anchored + 2D + arbitration (ours) | 4.1 | 6.9 | 4.6 | 76 | 93% |

## Self-check: do the validators catch bad rigs?

Full method, all runs (n=41). A run counts as a failure when MPJPE > 8 % H.

| Failures | Flagged by validators | True positives | False positives | Missed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 7 | 1 | 6 | 4 |
